query: db.properties.aggregate([ { $group: { _id: "$type", p50: { $percentile: { input: "$price", p: [0.1], method: "approximate" } }, p95: { $percentile: { input: "$price", p: [0.95], method: "approximate" } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, type: "$_id", p50: 1, p95: 1 } }])

db.properties.aggregate([ { $group: { _id: "$type", p50: { $percentile: { input: "$price", p: [0.5], method: "exact" } }, p95: { $percentile: { input: "$price", p: [0.95], method: "approximate" } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, type: "$_id", p50: 1, p95: 1 } }])
